tickets.title: Prepare appreciated stock donation analysis
tickets.text: Compare donating cash versus low-basis Paper Otter Robotics shares from Nora and Sam Velvetreed's Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account to the Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund at Silver Marmot Foundation. Include the expected reduction in concentration and the records needed for the transfer.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that appreciated stock donation analysis by March 20, 2024.

tickets.title: Review concentrated employer stock for charitable lots
tickets.text: Review the concentrated Paper Otter Robotics stock position in Nora and Sam Velvetreed's Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account for charitable lot selection. Several lots have large unrealized gains, including about $390,000 of stock with an estimated $265,000 embedded long-term gain.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review concentrated employer stock for charitable lots by March 27, 2024.

tickets.title: Address charitable giving timeline before filing closes

tickets.title: Support pending grant recommendation review

tickets.title: Address charitable plan after family caregiving change
tickets.text: Address Nora Velvetreed's charitable plan after her mother Hazel Velvetreed's move into assisted living. Consider adding a modest annual grant category for eldercare access organizations in Hazel's county.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the charitable plan after that family caregiving change by April 5, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare CPA-ready charitable documentation packet
tickets.text: Prepare a single packet for CPA Priya Dewspindle that separates Nora Velvetreed's donor-advised fund contributions, donor-advised fund grants, and any direct charitable gifts so deductible and non-deductible documentation do not mix.
